related.title: 安達索爾槽式太陽熱電廠
related.transfer: 可遷移「一個回路的導熱油流量」與「油鹽熱交換的溫度代價」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；安達索爾槽式太陽熱電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Oil flow in one loop" and "The temperature cost of oil-to-salt exchange" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Andasol Parabolic-Trough Solar Thermal Plants must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦美國第一座有熔鹽儲熱的大型槽式電廠：導熱油回路、油鹽換熱的代價與集熱管熱損；安達索爾槽式太陽熱電廠則以歐洲第一座商用槽式電廠與第一座商用熔鹽儲熱：回路數、儲熱量、太陽倍數與冬季的餘弦損失為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first large US trough plant with molten-salt storage: oil loops, the cost of oil-to-salt exchange and tube heat loss; Andasol Parabolic-Trough Solar Thermal Plants centres on europe's first commercial trough plant and the first commercial salt storage: loop count, stored heat, solar multiple and winter cosine loss, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鏡場面積與年發電量」與「鏡場面積與年發電量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「熱源溫度與循環效率」的模型移到安達索爾槽式太陽熱電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「冬至正午的餘弦損失」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Field aperture and annual energy" and "Field aperture and annual energy".
Move the model of "Source temperature and cycle efficiency" to Andasol Parabolic-Trough Solar Thermal Plants, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Cosine loss at winter solstice noon", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「一個回路的導熱油流量」與「油鹽熱交換的溫度代價」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；安達索爾槽式太陽熱電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Oil flow in one loop" and "The temperature cost of oil-to-salt exchange" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Andasol Parabolic-Trough Solar Thermal Plants must be respecified.

related.title: 熔鹽儲熱槽保溫與監測
related.titleEn: Molten Salt Thermal Storage Insulation and Monitoring
related.transfer: 可遷移「一個回路的導熱油流量」與「油鹽熱交換的溫度代價」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；熔鹽儲熱槽保溫與監測的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Oil flow in one loop" and "The temperature cost of oil-to-salt exchange" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Molten Salt Thermal Storage Insulation and Monitoring must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦美國第一座有熔鹽儲熱的大型槽式電廠：導熱油回路、油鹽換熱的代價與集熱管熱損；熔鹽儲熱槽保溫與監測則以五百多度的熔鹽大槽：保溫、熱膨脹、槽壁應力、伴熱防凝與鹽量盤點為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first large US trough plant with molten-salt storage: oil loops, the cost of oil-to-salt exchange and tube heat loss; Molten Salt Thermal Storage Insulation and Monitoring centres on large tanks of salt above five hundred degrees: insulation, thermal expansion, wall stress, heat tracing and salt inventory, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「鏡場面積與年發電量」與「鏡場面積與年發電量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「熱源溫度與循環效率」的模型移到熔鹽儲熱槽保溫與監測，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「一天的溫降」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Field aperture and annual energy" and "Field aperture and annual energy".
Move the model of "Source temperature and cycle efficiency" to Molten Salt Thermal Storage Insulation and Monitoring, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Temperature drop in a day", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「一個回路的導熱油流量」與「油鹽熱交換的溫度代價」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；熔鹽儲熱槽保溫與監測的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Oil flow in one loop" and "The temperature cost of oil-to-salt exchange" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Molten Salt Thermal Storage Insulation and Monitoring must be respecified.
